A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the heterokonts form a monophyletic group that is closely related to the red algae and the stramenopiles (including the oomycetes, diatoms, brown and yellow-green algae).

The main takeaway from our work is that

, in the LSU rRNA phylogeny of eukaryotes, the heterokonts are a monophyletic group, and that the relationships between the classes of heteroknot algae can be resolved by combining SSU and LSU sequence data.
